svg.title: Thalweg agent workflow: perception, decision, action
svg.desc: Mandatory OpenCV 5 perception prefix, then a brain (autopilot or LLM) that proposes tool calls which a code-enforced policy gate checks. Exactly one of three decisions ends the run: PUBLISH only when the stated basis holds, HOLD with a recapture request, or ESCALATE to a hydrologist. Errors fail closed. After a PUBLISH, station physics may draft a flood warning that only a person can sign.
svg.text: Perception → decision → action for one clip on the Graviton4 worker. The brain only proposes; code decides what may run and what may be published.

No agent tool can issue a warning. The only tools that end a run are publish_gauging, hold_and_request_recapture and escalate_to_hydrologist. Warnings are drafted by station code after a published gauging
and reach public/warnings.json only through a human signature on the review API.
